description: This Java source file defines the DefaultDeviceResolver class, which implements authentication interfaces for CoAP devices in the Eclipse Hono framework. It handles device credential retrieval, PSK key management, and identity resolution.

classes.name: DefaultDeviceResolver
classes.description: Implements device authentication and PSK management for CoAP devices in Eclipse Hono.

methods.name: getCandidateKey
methods.description: Extracts the pre-shared key from credentials record.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info based on client principal.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Retrieves the PSK for a given identity.

methods.name: getSharedKeyForDevice
methods.description: Fetches the shared key for a device identity.

methods.name: getIdentity
methods.description: Unsupported method for obtaining identity from InetSocketAddress.

methods.name: getHandshakeIdentity
methods.description: Creates tenant-aware device identity from handshake info.
